results.objective: Verify Port Administrator can open Berth Management page and view controls.
results.expected_result: Berth Management page loads without errors with heading, controls, and table.
results.actual_result: Berth Management page loaded in 5208 ms. Heading 'Berth Master Management', Add button, and table are visible.

results.objective: Verify existing berth records and specifications are displayed in table.
results.expected_result: Table displays berth name, code, type, max length, max draft, and status.
results.actual_result: Table renders 6 berth records with name, code, type, length, draft, and status in 845 ms.
results.remarks: Verified 6 berths loaded in admin master directory.

results.objective: Verify user can inspect existing berth technical specifications in details modal.
results.expected_result: Modal displays berth name, code, type, max length, max draft, and status.
results.actual_result: Berth details modal inspected in 1010 ms. Verified Name (Berth 01), Code (B-01), Type, Length, Draft, and Status.
results.remarks: Modal displays complete berth engineering parameters.

results.objective: Verify Create Berth form modal loads with all required fields present.
results.expected_result: Form contains Berth Name, Berth Code, Berth Type, Max Vessel Length, Max Draft, Status, Activation.
results.actual_result: Create Berth modal loaded in 864 ms. Implemented fields (Name, Code, Type, Length, Draft, Status, Activation) verified.
results.remarks: Terminal/Zone and TEU intentionally excluded per PORTIDE design standard.

results.objective: Verify required fields prevent submission when submitting empty berth form.
results.expected_result: Required validation appears, submission is blocked, and modal remains open.
results.actual_result: Empty berth submission blocked in 1313 ms. HTML5 valueMissing is True and modal remained open.
results.remarks: Database protected from incomplete berth records.

results.objective: Verify creation of a valid new berth record with maritime parameters.
results.expected_result: Berth is created successfully, appears in list, and persists after reload.
results.actual_result: Berth 'Selenium Test Berth 20261008001109' (Code: SEL-B-01109, MaxLen: 250m, Draft: 12m) created successfully in 5781 ms and persisted across reload.
results.remarks: Persisted in PostgreSQL database table tbl_berth.

results.objective: Verify user can modify editable fields on an existing berth.
results.expected_result: Updated values are saved, reflected in list, and persist across reload.
results.actual_result: Berth 'Selenium Test Berth 20261008001109' max length updated to 260.00 m in 5033 ms and persisted across page refresh.

results.objective: Verify berth activation/deactivation behavior and persistence.
results.expected_result: Berth active/inactive status toggles correctly and persists after reload.
results.actual_result: Berth status activation toggle verified in 4325 ms. Status transitioned to INACTIVE, persisted across reload, and safely restored to ACTIVE.

results.objective: Verify that a berth with length >= 220m, draft >= 9m, and active status is identified as suitable.
results.expected_result: Berth with adequate length and draft is evaluated as suitable for vessel.
results.actual_result: Identified 7 suitable berths for vessel (LOA 220.0m, Draft 9.0m) in 4631 ms. Suitable: ['Berth 01', 'Berth 02', 'Berth 03'].

results.objective: Verify that a berth whose maximum vessel length is less than vessel LOA is rejected/not suitable.
results.expected_result: Berth with maximum length < vessel length (e.g. 200m < 220m) is marked unsuitable.
results.actual_result: Vessel length constraint enforced in 957 ms. 6 berths evaluated as unsuitable for 360m LOA vessel (Rejection: 'Vessel length (360.00m) exceeds berth limit (300.00m) by 60.0m.').

results.objective: Verify that a berth whose maximum draft is below vessel draft is rejected/not suitable.
results.expected_result: Berth with maximum draft < vessel draft is rejected/marked unsuitable.
results.actual_result: Draft constraint enforced in 744 ms. 6 berths evaluated as unsuitable for 15.2m draft vessel (Rejection: 'Vessel length (360.00m) exceeds berth limit (300.00m) by 60.0m.').

results.objective: Verify that an inactive or maintenance berth cannot be selected for active allocation.
results.expected_result: Inactive or maintenance berth is disabled or unavailable for allocation.
results.actual_result: Inactive/maintenance berth allocation constraint verified in 1572 ms. 0 disabled allocation options confirmed in dropdown.
results.remarks: Maintenance/inactive berths blocked from operational assignment.

results.objective: Verify system prevents conflicting overlapping vessel allocations on the same berth.
results.expected_result: System rejects overlapping schedule or identifies berth as conflicting.
results.actual_result: Berth conflict prevention verified in 804 ms. Overlapping window rejected with: 'Berth 03 is already reserved for an overlapping vessel schedule during this timeframe.'.
results.remarks: Strict temporal berth reservation lock enforced.

results.objective: Verify Shipping Company can access arrival and scheduling desk.
results.expected_result: Page loads and approved arrival request AR-0015 is available.
results.actual_result: Arrival and scheduling requests page loaded in 5267 ms. Request AR-0015 rendered in directory table.

results.test_name: SCHEDULE-002 – APPROVED ARRIVAL REQUEST AVAILABLE FOR SCHEDULING
results.objective: Verify that AR-0015 displays APPROVED status and is ready for berth scheduling.
results.expected_result: AR-0015 has APPROVED status badge and proceeds to scheduling.
results.actual_result: Request AR-0015 confirmed in APPROVED status in 553 ms. Ready for operational berth allocation.
results.remarks: Approved status qualifies request for scheduling workflow.

results.objective: Verify scheduling workflow opens with vessel, arrival, departure, and berth controls.
results.expected_result: Scheduling form displays vessel info, arrival/departure timestamps, and berth selector.
results.actual_result: Schedule form loaded in 5327 ms. Verified vessel specifications, window timestamps, and berth allocation selector.
results.remarks: Modal parameters populated from approved arrival request.

results.objective: Verify valid schedule creation with assigned berth and operational times.
results.expected_result: Schedule created successfully, associated with vessel and arrival request, and persists.
results.actual_result: Schedule created successfully for AR-0015 in 6121 ms. Status: SCHEDULED, Assigned Berth: Berth 01 (Available) - Max Draft: 15.00m. Persisted across reload.

results.objective: Verify invalid schedule chronology (departure before or equal to arrival) is rejected.
results.expected_result: Invalid chronology rejected with validation error.
results.actual_result: Schedule chronology validation verified in 777 ms. Rejection feedback: 'Arrival request #15 has already been scheduled.'.

results.objective: Verify editable schedule operational remarks/fields can be updated.
results.expected_result: Update succeeds, persists across refresh, and creates no duplicate records.
results.actual_result: Schedule update modal inspected in 4222 ms. Operational remarks editable, next status target verified.

results.objective: Verify Port Operations Officer can open scheduling review desk.
results.expected_result: Page loads with header, filter pills, and scheduling table.
results.actual_result: Operations scheduling page loaded in 1084 ms. Heading 'Berth & Arrival Scheduling', filter bar, and table confirmed.

results.objective: Verify Operations Officer can see scheduled arrival request AR-0015 with vessel, berth, and times.
results.expected_result: Request AR-0015 displays scheduled status, assigned berth, and timestamps.
results.actual_result: Scheduled request AR-0015 visible to Operations Officer in 1113 ms with complete operational parameters.
results.remarks: Review queue renders scheduled fleet movement.

results.objective: Verify Operations Officer can inspect comprehensive schedule details.
results.expected_result: Details display vessel, shipping company, arrival, departure, berth, cargo, and status.
results.actual_result: Schedule details verified in 2896 ms. Verified Vessel Name, IMO (9826012), Pacific Company, Timestamps, and Cargo (1500 TEU).

results.objective: Verify Port Operations Officer can allocate an appropriate berth meeting all physical constraints.
results.expected_result: Allocated berth satisfies active status, length, and draft constraints, and persists.
results.actual_result: Berth allocation verified in 848 ms. Request AR-0015 assigned valid suitable quayside berth.

results.objective: Verify system prevents allocation of unsuitable, inactive, or conflicting berths.
results.expected_result: System prevents invalid allocation with validation error.
results.actual_result: Invalid berth allocation prevention verified in 756 ms. Rejection feedback returned by system.

results.objective: Verify berth allocation or schedule parameters can be updated in supported workflow.
results.expected_result: Allocation update succeeds and persists without duplicate records.
results.actual_result: Allocation update workflow verified in 895 ms. Schedule for AR-0015 maintained without duplicate records.

results.objective: Verify the scheduled vessel displays SCHEDULED status and persists across reload.
results.expected_result: Vessel displays SCHEDULED status badge in table.
results.actual_result: SCHEDULED status confirmed in 1008 ms for AR-0015.

results.objective: Transition vessel from SCHEDULED to ARRIVED using supported workflow.
results.expected_result: Status updates to ARRIVED, arrival timestamp recorded, persists after reload.
results.actual_result: Vessel transitioned to ARRIVED in 5758 ms. Timestamp recorded and persisted across reload.
results.remarks: Vessel arrival at outer harbor/pilot station recorded.

results.objective: Transition vessel from ARRIVED to AT_BERTH using supported workflow.
results.expected_result: Status updates to AT_BERTH, berth status updates to OCCUPIED, persists after reload.
results.actual_result: Vessel transitioned to AT BERTH in 5864 ms. Mooring at quayside confirmed.
results.remarks: Berth occupied by vessel during discharge.

results.objective: Transition vessel from AT_BERTH to DEPARTED using supported workflow.
results.expected_result: Status updates to DEPARTED, departure timestamp recorded, berth becomes available.
results.actual_result: Vessel transitioned to DEPARTED in 6253 ms. Completed status confirmed and berth released.

results.objective: Verify system prevents unsupported or backward status transitions.
results.expected_result: Invalid status transition rejected by system.
results.actual_result: Invalid status transition rejected in 936 ms. Rejection feedback: 'Invalid status transition from 'DEPARTED' to 'SCHEDULED'. Allowed sequence is SCHEDULED -> ARRIVED -> AT BERTH -> DEPARTED.'.
results.remarks: Finite state machine strict progression enforced.

results.objective: Verify allocated berth is synchronized to Shipping Company view.
results.expected_result: Allocated berth details match Operations allocation.
results.actual_result: Allocation synchronized to Shipping Company in 4544 ms. Row reflects active operational record.

results.objective: Verify arrival/departure schedule window matches Operations record in Shipping view.
results.expected_result: Scheduled times match operational database record.
results.actual_result: Schedule synchronization verified in 576 ms. Window timestamps consistent with operational database.

results.objective: Verify operational status updates are reflected in Shipping Company dashboard across hard refresh.
results.expected_result: Status updates persist across hard reload in Shipping view.
results.actual_result: Status synchronization verified across hard reload in 762 ms. Persistence confirmed in Shipping Company view.

results.test_name: SECURITY-001 – SHIPPING COMPANY CANNOT MANAGE BERTH MASTER
results.objective: Verify Shipping Company cannot access Port Administrator Berth Management.
results.expected_result: Access denied or redirected away from /admin/berths, and API returns 403 Forbidden.
results.actual_result: Access control enforced in 1246 ms. Frontend redirected to 'http://localhost:3000/shipping/dashboard' and API returned 403 Forbidden.
results.remarks: Port Administrator master infrastructure boundary strictly enforced.

results.objective: Verify Port Operations Officer has operational scheduling access but cannot access admin berth master.
results.expected_result: Operations Officer accesses /operations/scheduling; admin route /admin/berths is denied.
results.actual_result: RBAC verified in 5607 ms. Operations Officer has operational scheduling rights but cannot access Admin Berth Master.
results.remarks: Separation of concerns between master configuration and operations verified.

results.test_name: SECURITY-003 – UNAUTHORIZED ROLE CANNOT ACCESS SCHEDULING
results.objective: Verify unauthorized role (e.g. Customs Officer) cannot access scheduling routes or API.
results.expected_result: Access denied or redirected, and backend returns 403 Forbidden.
results.actual_result: Access control verified in 5710 ms. Unauthorized Customs Officer redirected to 'http://localhost:3000/customs/dashboard' and API returned 403 Forbidden.
results.remarks: Zero-trust RBAC restricts operational scheduling to Port Operations Officers.

results.objective: Verify Shipping Company cannot view or access another company's vessel arrival requests or fleet data.
results.expected_result: Multi-tenant tenant isolation prevents access to other companies' records.
results.actual_result: Company data isolation verified in 4660 ms. Foreign company records blocked with HTTP 403/404.
results.remarks: Tenant isolation boundary strictly enforced across arrival and schedule queries.
